notes.title: 7th Domain:Tree of Chaos Update version 1.2.0
notes.content:
Dear players:

After going through a series of hardships, Photon Independent Game Studio has updated Lightimpact Independent Game Studio to version 1.2.0. While optimizing the version, we have also made some minor additions to the game.

It's not easy to develop indie games. On our way forward, we firmly believe that there will always be light shining on the road ahead.

Thank you again for your support.

We would like to apologize to players in the English, Japanese and German regions. Most of the translations were done by machine translation due to limited manpower and some practical issues. We will gradually fix some translation problems.

The following are the specific update details:
New Features in Version 1.2.0:

1. New challenge map - Black Tree Rift - Explosive Point Rift
Unlocking Condition: After completing or collecting the Netherworld events, the Explosive Point Rift will be unlocked in Milia. At this time, players can visit it to take on the challenge.
Challenge Content: This challenge is a random three-boss battle. It's a pure-kill map where players fight against three randomly selected super bosses within a time limit. and the highest equipment strength that can be dropped is up to the 150th tier.

2. New equipment refinement system
Unlocking Condition: It will be unlocked simultaneously with the Black Tree Explosive Point Rift, and the interaction object is Milia.
System Content: Players will be able to refresh the acquired white-attribute values into a new set of attributes by consuming the resources "Golden Rune Stones" and "Soul Power Fragments". The consumption for refining a single piece of equipment will increase incrementally.
Acquisition Route: Super bosses in the Explosive Point Rift will drop Golden Rune Stones.

3. Optimization of the Summoned Artifact System
The number of summoned artifacts that can be deployed in battle has changed from 1 to 3. They will be gradually unlocked according to the player's level.
The base physical attack and magic attack of the summoned artifacts have increased by 25%.

4. New summoned artifact enhancement system - Artifact Cultivation
Unlocking Condition: After completing the main story's Netherworld events, an NPC will appear in the village (if it doesn't appear, you can try leaving the village and coming back). Players can interact with it to upgrade.
System Content: Players can use Summoned Artifact Essences to enhance the damage of the corresponding summoned artifacts. The enhancement range for each cultivation is randomly determined according to the stage. With enough luck, you can achieve high damage.
Acquisition Route: Global bosses have a probability of dropping various Summoned Artifact Essences.

5. New weapons and combat actions.
Poison Mother - Staff Type - Fire Frog
Crystal Giant - One-Handed Sword Type - Fishbone
T001 - One-Handed Sword Type - Reincarnation
Gourmet - Two-Handed Sword Type - Long Handle - Beast Bone Axe Blade
Volcanic Molten Ape - Two-Handed Sword Type - Long Handle - Flaming Hammer Blade
Matthew Gate - Staff Type - Martial Fan - Thunderous Dance
Netherworld - Dagger Type - Demon Blade
The new weapons also have a chance of being dropped from world treasure chests.

6. New global equipment affixes added
Ctrl: For each summoned artifact deployed, the damage dealt by the protagonist increases by {x}%.
Sunflower: For each summoned artifact deployed, the damage received by the protagonist decreases by {x}%.
Familiar: The damage dealt by summoned artifacts increases by {x}%.

Other Optimizations in Version 1.2.0:

1. Optimize the fusion rate between action frames so that the state transitions can be smoother.
2. Optimize the white flash dynamic effect of short-distance teleportation to a black effect.
3. Optimize the clarity of some icons.

notes.title: Update version 1.1.6
notes.content:
[Modify and optimize content]
1. Fix bug
Brilliant Armor: Imperial affix
The previous effect reduces damage taken by x (3%~5%) for every 100 points of luck, with a maximum effect of 25%. The equipment effect obtained previously cannot be activated normally.
The new effect is modified to reduce the damage received by y (10~30%) when you have x lucky points (450~800).
Because the previous effect could not be activated normally, players need to collect the equipment again. I am very sorry to players who have already collected it before.

2. Optimize performance:
Optimize the frame rate drop problem when releasing skills.
Optimize the frame rate lag problem when running graphics.
Optimize some frame rate drops caused by continuously resetting the map.

notes.title: Update version 1.1.3
notes.content:
Dear players:
Thank you for supporting Seven Degrees of Desolation: Tree of Chaos

[Modify and optimize content]
1. Optimize the delay in movement when using the handle (the delay occurs when the handle is pushed halfway and pushed slightly).
2. Modify the affix: CD cooling reduction series failure problem. This BUG currently has a built-in CD conflict and has been fixed.
3. When using the handle to operate, the mouse icon will be automatically hidden. When clicking or using the keyboard, the mouse will reappear.
4. Restore the statistics of the achievement system.
5. Compatibility optimization, optimizing some situations where hardware compatibility may cause crashes.
